checkpoints.description: [1/6] Binding and promotion hardening: typed input hashing, normalized content digest, evidence_group, promotion requires verified evidence

impact_assessment.why: Probes proved directory/glob inputs hash nothing, a file containing 'missing' collides with an absent file, report --check false-alarms on every re-verify, and a NUMERIC claim can ride on evidence from a changed command
impact_assessment.benefits: Declared inputs actually bind; drift detects content not run allocation; promotions cite a specific verified group; the write path matches the gate
impact_assessment.risks: contract: verdict gains evidence_group and manifest gains content_sha256; dependency: none; concurrency: promotion and verification stay separate transactions; state: schema v3 migration must preserve v1/v2 rows and old verdicts must stay readable
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests per defect, additive migration with a notice, typed digest markers, deterministic glob expansion, and a --strict escape hatch for exact-record digests

checkpoints.description: [6/6] Hardening delivered: typed glob-aware input binding, semantic vs strict report digests, evidence_group promotion gate with EVID-006, migration notice, import cycles broken via engine/evidence.py; 134 tests pass; 4/4 AIKit gates pass; checklists: passed
Task 'T-003-binding-hardening' completed successfully.
[1/6] Analysis and agent views: token-budgeted outline/brief, contradiction discovery, evidence matrix, snapshot diff, UNKNOWN evidence state, claim merge

impact_assessment.why: The engine can audit a graph but cannot be read by an agent within a token budget, cannot surface unlinked contradictions, and cannot compare two snapshots
impact_assessment.benefits: Agents get bounded, deterministic views; contradictions are discoverable rather than only recorded; UNKNOWN stops missing data from counting as evidence; snapshots become comparable
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CLAIM_STATUSES gains UNKNOWN and consensus weights change; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: read-only analysis; state: merge rewrites edges and must preserve verdict history
impact_assessment.mitigation: Closed-vocabulary tests, deterministic ordering, explicit omitted counts, merge recorded as a verdict plus edges, and integrity codes for unresolved UNKNOWN

checkpoints.description: [6/6] Analysis and views delivered: token-budgeted outline/brief/claim context with OMITTED counts, contradiction discovery + unlinked proposals, evidence matrix, keystone ranking, exposure, semantic/exact snapshot diff, UNKNOWN evidence state with EVID-007, claim merge; 180 tests pass; 4/4 AIKit gates pass; checklists: passed
Task 'T-004-analysis-views' completed successfully.
[1/2] Review the uncommitted engine delivery for defects, fix confirmed gaps, then commit and publish

impact_assessment.why: The delivery has no remote and no review pass; four defects were suspected in the newest analysis surface
impact_assessment.benefits: Diff identity, contradiction scope, merge follow-through and scoped audit corrected; evidence chain stays attached through merges
impact_assessment.risks: contract: run identity in snapshots, record_edge rename, TEST-001 added; dependency: none; concurrency: read-only review plus transactional writes; state: merge now also rebinds tests
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first regression tests for each defect, full suite, gates and CLI acceptance before commit

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Review complete: four defects fixed (run identity in semantic diff, contradiction question scope, merge test rebinding with TEST-001, scoped outline audit), record_edge made public; 188 tests pass; 4/4 AIKit gates pass; checklists: passed
Task 'T-005-audit-review' completed successfully.

[1/2] Adopt mechanics from N1-Engine, Aegean licensing, lattice, obezite and fluid-universe: negative controls, screening/PRISMA, event log, verified backup, safe markdown, domain-separated digests, licence identity

impact_assessment.why: Seven reference projects were reviewed at code level; six mechanics fill verified gaps in the engine's falsifiability, audit trail, state safety and output integrity
impact_assessment.benefits: Vacuity detectable; screening auditable; every non-verdict action logged; state verifiable and copyable; untrusted text cannot alter documents; digests and licence are unambiguous
impact_assessment.risks: contract: schema v4 adds screening, control and event columns; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single-writer transactions; state: migration must preserve v1-v3 rows and legacy tests must keep verifying
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests per mechanic, additive v4 migration with event record, demo updated with a control, and full gate run before commit

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Cross-project mechanics delivered: negative-control kill tests (EVID-008/009), screening + PRISMA (SCREEN-001), append-only event log, db integrity + verified backup, safe markdown rendering, domain-separated digests, licence identity in manifest; schema v4; 235 tests pass; 4/4 AIKit gates pass; checklists: passed
Task 'T-006-cross-project-mechanics' completed successfully.
[1/2] Adopt N1-Engine's measurement analysis: append-only observations, deterministic stdlib statistics, seeded bootstrap, exact/asymptotic rank test, OBS-001

impact_assessment.why: The strongest unported mechanic was turning repeated measurements into an effect size and interval; the engine could only hash a command's output
impact_assessment.benefits: Numeric claims can rest on recorded values; results are reproducible for a fixed seed; assumptions and test disagreement are disclosed
impact_assessment.risks: contract: schema v5 adds observation; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: single-writer; state: voiding must preserve the record and the migration must add the table to v1-v4 databases
impact_assessment.mitigation: Values checked against an independent implementation, exact/asymptotic methods tested, void semantics tested, and v4->v5 migration covered

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Observations and statistics delivered: append-only observation table, observation add/list/void, analysis stats with Cohen's d, Welch t, exact/asymptotic Mann-Whitney and seeded bootstrap, claim.stats event, OBS-001 warning; schema v5; 272 tests pass; 4/4 AIKit gates pass; checklists: passed
Task 'T-007-observations-stats' completed successfully.
